groupingName.tooltip: A name that describes the purpose of this grouping.
groupingName.label: Grouping Name

description.tooltip: Provide a concise summary or overview of the {{nodeType}} content. Include key topics, purpose, scope, and any important features.
description.label: Description

bok.tooltip: List of Body of Knowledge concepts addressed in the {{nodeType}}.
bok.label: Knowledge Annotations

eqf.tooltip: The European Qualifications Framework. Indicates level of knowledge, skills and competences, from 1 (basic) to 8 (highly specialized).
eqf.label: EQF Level

description.general: The 8 EQF levels describe the knowledge, skills and autonomy expected at each qualification level.
description.eqf2: EQF 2: Basic knowledge and routine tasks with some autonomy.
description.eqf3: EQF 3: Basic concepts, problem-solving and task responsibility.
description.eqf4: EQF 4: Theoretical knowledge, problem-solving and independent work.
description.eqf5: EQF 5: Specialised knowledge, complex problem-solving and management.
description.eqf6: EQF 6: Advanced knowledge, complex decisions and project management.
description.eqf7: EQF 7: Highly specialised knowledge, research and innovation.
description.eqf8: EQF 8: Expert knowledge, research leadership and innovation.

tooltips.ects: Amount of time expected to invest in order to meet the defined learning outcomes, quantified using ECTS.
tooltips.hours: Amount of time expected to invest in order to meet the defined learning outcomes, quantified using hours.

duration.tooltip: The total time required to complete this {{nodeType}}.
duration.label: Duration

studyAreas.tooltip: Specific area(s) of study of the {{nodeType}}. Maintained by the UNESCO Institute for Statistics.
studyAreas.label: Study Areas
studyAreas.description: The International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED) provides a globally agreed framework for categorising education programmes and qualifications, enabling cross- national comparison of education systems.

courseType.tooltip: Select the type of course. This classification determines how the course fits within the curriculum structure.
courseType.label: Course Type

description.general: Defines the role of the course within the curriculum.
description.common: Select Common for courses that are mandatory for all students in a programme.
description.elective: Select Elective for courses students can choose from a set of available options.
description.specialization: Select Specialization for courses focused on a specific subject area or field of study.

assessment.tooltip: Describe how students will be evaluated in this course. Include assessment methods (exams, projects, participation), grading criteria, and any relevant deadlines or requirements.
assessment.label: Assessment

lecturePractical.tooltip: Specifies whether this lecture is theoretical or practical. Practical lectures involve hands-on activities, labs, or exercises.

affiliations.tooltip: The institution or organization offering or otherwise associated with this {{nodeType}}.
affiliations.label: Affiliations

trainingMaterials.tooltip: Resources and materials used to support the teaching of this {{nodeType}}.
trainingMaterials.label: Training Materials

prerequisites.tooltip: Prerequisites describe the knowledge, skills, qualifications, or experiences that a learner is expected to have before starting this {{nodeType}}.
prerequisites.label: Prerequisites

learningOutcomes.tooltip: Learning outcomes describe the knowledge, skills, qualifications, or experiences that a learner is expected to have after completing this {{nodeType}}.
learningOutcomes.label: Learning Outcomes

bibliography.tooltip: Bibliography describe the recommended reading materials, resources, or references related to this {{nodeType}}.
bibliography.label: Bibliography

transversalSkills.tooltip: Skills considered unrelated to a particular job, task, academic discipline or area of knowledge but that can be used in a wide variety of situations and work settings. Based on the ESCO transversal and cross-sector skills.
transversalSkills.label: Transversal Skills
transversalSkills.description: Our transversal skills input uses the Transversal skills classification from the ESCO skills pillar. ESCO provides preferred terms and alternative terms across 28 languages, along with descriptions and related information for each concept.

customTransversalSkills.tooltip: Custom transversal skills related to this {{nodeType}}.
customTransversalSkills.label: Custom Transversal Skills
